discovery.title: What else you'll discover
discovery.hint: Move your mouse — the flashlight reveals 🔦
discovery.a1b: We make tests engaging for primary and senior students alike, using every tool we can.
discovery.a2b: We build tests for every subject in the curriculum, not just one or two — today's world expects all-round knowledge.
discovery.a3b: Using the site costs just 15,000 UZS a month — full access to every material for a whole month.
discovery.learnTitle: Learning is actually a joyful adventure!
discovery.learnBody: At QuvnoqTest.uz we treat learning as something fascinating and important. Our ancestors studied not for income or diplomas, but out of curiosity (astronomy, poetry) or to serve society (mathematics, medicine) — and reached great heights. We want to spark that same curiosity.
discovery.c2: The numbers in the examples change, so you can repeat and practise as much as you like — endless practice
discovery.c3: Collecting puzzle pieces and other game elements
discovery.c4: An AI helper is ready for your questions!
discovery.devBody: Open a browser on your computer, tablet or phone, type QuvnoqTest.uz and start learning.
discovery.q1: Which books and materials are the tests based on?
discovery.fa1: The tests are built from school textbooks using modern technology and edited by our team. The number of topics matches that of the textbooks.
discovery.q2: Can several students share one subscription?
discovery.fa2: You can, but it's inconvenient — only the latest result is kept for grading.
discovery.q3: Can a test be retaken after finishing?
discovery.fa3: Yes, of course — you can restart a test to reinforce your knowledge or simply try again.
discovery.fa4: Nothing in particular. We make tests engaging and clear so children work for the joy of it, not for a grade. A student who truly wants to learn won't cheat — and one who does gains nothing for themselves.
discovery.p1b: Full, unlimited access to the site
discovery.p2b: Try our tests and the site for free
